title: Fixed Walking Drum Timber Hoist
description: One newly authored whole fixed traditional walking-drum timber hoist appearance. A full broad open-ended annular drum has a continuous inside tread and two spoke ends, on a complete supported horizontal shaft. A smaller integral rope-winding drum shares the shaft in the adjacent tower bay. Ground sills and transverse ties support full low bearing posts and a braced upper timber tower with forward boom, carried top sheave and continuous rope route down to an empty open hook. This is not an enlarged water paddle wheel or a recoloured crank tripod: the broad inward walking cylinder and integrated shaft/hoisting tower form a distinct complete layout. No imported old asset meshes; three opaque PBR materials, metres, centred horizontal ground origin. One static prop, no scene. No human, rotation, walking operation, lifting, torque, rope mechanics, loads, manufacture or safety certification.
